subject: Candidate update: same-day illness — take-home + panel coverage plan
messages:
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: URGENT - candidate reporting illness for Monday's loop

Hi team,

Samira (final loop scheduled Monday 11/9 at 10:00 PT) just messaged — she woke up with a fever and sore throat and says she tested positive on a home rapid. Shes uncomfortable doing a live coding + whiteboard at full intensity.

Options I wanted to float:
- Move the entire final loop to next week (candidate provided availability 11/16-11/20 in the afternoon PT), or
- Switch the coding portion to an unproctored take-home assignment (we provide 48 hours) + keep a shorter 30-min behavioral screen on Monday to avoid losing momentum.

She asked if we could make a same-day decision so she can plan. I've attached her updated resume and can ping scheduling links if we decide to reschedule.

Can you both weigh in? Marcus — do you prefer reschedule or take-home + short sync? Laura — would you be available to cover the system-design portion if we keep a short live interview?

Thanks,
Monica

--
Monica Patel
Technical Recruiter | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
From: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
To: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 09:27:00 -0800
Subject: Re: URGENT - candidate reporting illness for Monday's loop

Thanks for the heads up, Monica.

High-level preference: keep momentum with a hybrid approach so we don't push the process out unnecessarily. Proposal:
1) Convert the live coding/whiteboard to a take-home assignment (48-hour window) — Ill attach the take-home brief and rubric.
2) Keep a 30-min behavioral/culture sync on Monday at 10:00 PT (candidate still comfortable with a shorter virtual touchpoint) — that preserves the chance to move fast on fit.
3) For system-design (originally scheduled with Marcus), Laura can join the 30-min if you're fine covering the design portion in a short format; otherwise we can move that to a separate 45-min slot next week.

If we go this route, Monica: please send the take-home doc and updated calendar invite (I'll create a short "Behavioral - Samira Q" invite). Marcus, if you prefer to interview live for design next week, please indicate 2 windows and Monica will coordinate.

Ill also plan to add a 5-business-day feedback window so reviewers are synchronized.

-Jasmine
Jasmine Liu
Sr. Talent Partner | Redwood Inference
jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
From: Samira Qureshi <samira.qureshi@gmail.com>
To: monica.patel@redwoodinference.com, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 09:44:20 -0800
Subject: Re: URGENT - candidate reporting illness for Monday's loop

Hi Monica / Jasmine / team,

Thanks for checking — I really appreciate the flexibility. I did a home rapid and its positive; Im feeling pretty wiped out and would rather not do two hours of live coding. The hybrid plan sounds perfect.

Im happy to do: 48-hour take-home for the coding question (start as soon as Monday morning) + a 30-min behavioral call at 10:00 PT on Monday. If you need me to move the behavior call a bit earlier/later I can try to accommodate depending on symptoms.

Availability for a full live system-design follow-up: 11/16–11/20 afternoons PT (any 1:00–4:30 PT slot works).

Thanks again for understanding — Im still excited about the role and want to ensure I can do my best work.

Best,
Samira
(she/her)
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com>
To: jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com, monica.patel@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -0800
Subject: Re: URGENT - candidate reporting illness for Monday's loop

Thanks for the context. I prefer the hybrid approach Jasmine outlined — well do the take-home + 30-min touchpoint Monday. Laura, if youre OK, can you take the 30-min slot and do a concise design/fit probe (15-20 mins) and leave the detailed system-design to next week?

Monica: please set the take-home deadline to 48 hours and include the rubric we use for take-homes. Also put the next-week design follow-up (11/16-11/20) as "tentative" and ask for two preferred windows.

Ill defer to hiring on whether to extend an offer contingent on take-home + final design follow-up, but my sense is we should remain aggressive if the take-home is strong.

-Marcus
Engineering Manager
From: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwoodinference.com>
To: samira.qureshi@gmail.com, jasmine.liu@redwoodinference.com
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodinference.com, marcus.lin@redwoodinference.com
Date: Sun, 7 Nov 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: URGENT - candidate reporting illness for Monday's loop

Samira — thanks for confirming and feel better soon. Ive attached the take-home brief (interview_takehome.md) and set the deadline for 48 hours from when you acknowledge starting it. Please reply here to confirm start time so we can lock the deadline.

Ive also created an updated calendar invite: "Behavioral - Samira Q" for Mon 11/9 10:00 PT (calendar_invite_20261109.ics attached). Laura, youre on that invite; Marcus, I left the design follow-up as tentative 11/16 1:30 PT — Samira, feel free to propose two alternate windows in that range.

Attachments: Samira_Qureshi_resume.pdf, interview_takehome.md, calendar_invite_20261109.ics

Regards,
Monica
